title: Luna: add composable rewrite suggestions
description:
Implements LIM-ee79f5. Begin with its revised Gherkin scenarios.

Scope:
- Add an optional suggestion primitive that accepts the full draft, portable profile, diagnostics/annotations, and reference samples.
- Optional findings or caller guidance may focus a request; neither may be required or impose a patch-only response.
- Return review-only candidates with rationale, unresolved questions, factual-verification warnings, and a reviewable diff.
- Keep the source draft unchanged. Do not couple suggestion generation to apply, verification, provenance, or publish commands.

Definition of done:
- Callers can use diagnose alone, suggestions alone, or compose suggestions with other existing tools.
- A candidate can address multiple findings coherently.
- Tests cover unguided and guidance-focused requests, source preservation, and forbidden detector-evasion tactics.

Out of scope: workflow modes, mandatory decision records, enforced edit order, unattended rewrite/apply, publication, and telemetry.
